source_text: Courts reference policy statements from the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), which in 2012 concluded preventive health benefits—reduced penile cancer (lifetime risk drop from 1 in 100,000 to near zero), HIV acquisition (60% relative reduction in heterosexual transmission), and urinary tract infections—outweigh risks but do not warrant universal policy. [196] [197]
